quest.title: Hidden Mercenaries
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is where the notes mentioned that Thutmose would suddenly appear and then disappear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it has been such a long time, so even if there was a hiding spot, it should be abandoned by now, shouldn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, never mind! They're still around! We've gotta keep our voices down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This means they probably do have a secret hideout around here — and that means treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Soheil's notes did mention that the Eremites here would appear and disappear out of the blue. They sure sound like a dangerous bunch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about we quietly observe the surroundings for a while and figure out this place's secret?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, this chest has a bunch of random junk in it... and a battered stone slate?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those researchers would be super mad if they found out that the mercenaries just stashed it away like this.
